#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int add(int a, int b, int MOD) {
    int res = a + b;
    if (res >= MOD) {
        res -= MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    int N = 2 * n;
    const int MOD = 1000000007;
    // Initialize 3D DP array with size (N+1) x (N+1) x 2, filled with 0
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>> dp(N + 1, std::vector<std::vector<int>>(N + 1, std::vector<int>(2, 0)));
    // Base cases are already zero

    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= 1; ++k) {
                if (k == 1) {
                    if (i - j >= 2) {
                        dp[i][j][k] = add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j + 1][0], MOD);
                    }
                    if (j > 0) {
                        dp[i][j][k] = add(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j - 1][0], MOD);
                    }
                } else {
                    // k == 0
                    int val = 0;
                    // getVal for selectStart=false, selectEnd=false
                    if (i - j >= 2) {
                        val = std::max(val, add(dp[i -1][j + 1][0], 0, MOD));
                    }
                    // getVal for selectStart=false, selectEnd=true
                    if (j > 0) {
                        val = std::max(val, add(dp[i -1][j -1][0], 0, MOD));
                    }
                    // getVal for selectStart=true, selectEnd=false
                    if (i - j >= 2) {
                        int temp = add(dp[i -1][j + 1][1], 1, MOD);
                        val = std::max(val, temp);
                    }
                    // getVal for selectStart=false, selectEnd=true
                    if (j > 0) {
                        int temp = add(dp[i -1][j -1][1], 1, MOD);
                        val = std::max(val, temp);
                    }
                    dp[i][j][k] = val;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << dp[N][0][0] << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
